description: In crates/core/src/group_log/backfill.rs, want_parent_ids is captured by checking 'if visited.len() == 1' on the first dequeue, relying on the assumption that want_id is inserted into the queue first and thus always the first entry visited. This is true today because want_id seeds the VecDeque before the BFS loop, but there is no assertion or documentation of this invariant. A future refactor (e.g. multi-root backfill) that changes queue seeding order would silently capture the wrong node's parents. Fix: capture parent_cids directly after the first storage.get_entry(want_id) call before the BFS loop, removing the fragile index-based detection.
title: backfill: silent invariant that want_id is always dequeued first
